ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-grey vs 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity perimeter along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips. Concentrated low-intensity mottling at the fluke base. Right lobe features three distinct diagonal linear dark streaks and one focal dark spot. Left lobe features two primary circular dark spots and sparse grey stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 65 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the fluke mid-line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Includes at least three distinct deep V-shaped notches on the left lobe and two on the right lobe, isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curve originating from the median notch, sweeping outward to slightly acute, barnacle-encrusted lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, textured circular calcifications (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three prominent, roughly parallel dark linear streaks on the mid-right lobe; shorter, less defined linear marks are visible on the left lobe near the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; multiple irregular, jagged notches along the trailing edge; significant diagonal rake marks on the inner right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'V' shaped dark scratch pattern on the inner right lobe.
